title: The Log Nobody Could Search: Categories, Filter Rules, a Severity That Is Not in Order and a Log That Keeps the Last Thousand
fallback: This lesson is about the log of a running program, so it needs Qt. Lesson 04-02 is about reading a crash and lesson 05-05 about a fake that records what it was given, in plain C++. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a bounded log of what Qt printed, with its category, that can be asked for the messages of one part of a program at one severity or worse
